subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should #100121 remain the combined tracking issue for exec-warning plus zero-payload/tool-error fallback semantics now that the provider placeholder branch is fixed, or should the remaining work move to narrower canonical issues such as #97324 and the exec-warning policy thread?
rationale: The remaining behavior decides when OpenClaw should surface or suppress user-visible failure text after tool errors, which is a product/runtime policy boundary rather than a mechanical one-line repair.

options.title: Keep #100121 as the combined P1
options.body: Use this issue to define the terminal contract for no-reply exec/tool failures and land one focused follow-up that coordinates warning and fallback behavior.

options.title: Split to narrower canonicals
options.body: Close or de-scope this issue after explicitly routing placeholder, incomplete-turn, and exec-warning policy work to separate canonical items.

options.title: Wait for live beta proof
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer code work until a live channel reproduction proves the remaining no-reply branch still occurs after the provider fixes.

recommendation.title: Keep #100121 as the combined P1
recommendation.body: Use this issue to define the terminal contract for no-reply exec/tool failures and land one focused follow-up that coordinates warning and fallback behavior.
